title: mRNA Encapsulation
author: Opentrons
materials: The protocol will alert the user to ensure buffers are present in the reservoir in sufficient volume.

steps.title: Configure robot and load deck
steps.instruction: Load the Opentrons deck according to the provided JSON deck map, using single‑channel P300 and P1000 pipettes; plan transfers so that all transfers for the first test plate are completed before starting the next plate, and be prepared to pause the robot to remove completed plates. Use multi pre‑air gaps with multiple aspirations to enable repeat top‑dispenses without blowout, tip touch, or tip drop.

steps.title: Verify buffer volumes
steps.instruction: When prompted, confirm that all required buffers are present in the reservoir in sufficient volume.

steps.title: Dispense PBS to sample plate
steps.instruction: Using the P1000, perform repeated top‑dispenses of PBS to the first two rows of the sample plate, employing multi pre‑air gaps; no blowout or tip touch is needed.

steps.title: Transfer sample to sample plate
steps.instruction: Using the P300 single‑channel, repeatedly top‑dispense sample from row A of the tube rack to the first two rows of the sample plate, with multi pre‑air gaps and without blowout or tip touch.

steps.title: Add TE to first test plate
steps.instruction: Using both the P300 single‑channel and the P1000, repeatedly top‑dispense TE to the first test plate, employing multi pre‑air gaps; no blowout or tip touch required.

steps.title: Add TE‑Triton to test plate
steps.instruction: Using the P1000 and P300 single‑channel, repeatedly top‑dispense TE‑Triton to the first test plate with multi pre‑air gaps; no blowout or tip touch.

steps.title: Transfer sample to test plate
steps.instruction: Using the P300 single‑channel, repeatedly top‑dispense sample from the sample plate to the first test plate, using multi pre‑air gaps; no blowout or tip touch.

steps.title: Dispense mRNA stock to test plate
steps.instruction: Using the P1000, repeatedly top‑dispense mRNA stock to the first test plate; multi pre‑air gaps are used.

steps.title: Create mRNA dilution series
steps.instruction: Using the P300 single‑channel, mix and prepare a dilution series of the mRNA stock directly in the first test plate.

steps.title: Repeat steps for additional rows
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 3‑9 for tube‑rack rows B, C, and D and their corresponding test plates, following the same order and parameters.
